note: pilot-a: the whole story in 5 lines, ~20 s, one narrator (Achird).

lines.text: Every thirty-nine feet, he cut a gap in his own railroad.
His trains rattled over every gap, while the rival's tight rails ran smooth and silent.
Then summer came, and the steel began to grow.
On the hottest day, his gaps closed, rail against rail.
The rival's perfect track had nowhere to go, so it bent like a snake.
